# Phillips

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P73](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0073)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolmaster at Avonlea School  <sub>[v1 c15 P27](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0027), [v1 c15 P31](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0031), [v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037)</sub>

## Personality

He is perceived by some as carrying matters with a high hand, displaying injustice in his discipline. He frequently directs his attention toward older female students like Prissy Andrews rather than actively supervising the whole classroom.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P31](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0031), [v1 c15 P83](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0083), [v1 c15 P89](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0089)_

## Traits

- Inattentive teacher  <sub>[v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P31](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0031)</sub>
- Unfair disciplinarian  <sub>[v1 c15 P89](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0089)</sub>

## Abilities

- Teaching Latin, geometry, French, and algebra  <sub>[v1 c15 P27](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0027), [v1 c15 P31](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0031), [v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037)</sub>

## History

Mr. Phillips served as the schoolmaster at Avonlea School. During his tenure, he courted one of his older pupils, Prissy Andrews, frequently spending class time giving her individual instruction in Latin and algebra, and visiting her home in the evenings. His teaching style and strict, sometimes unequal discipline led to friction with students like Anne Shirley, whom he punished by making her sit with Gilbert Blythe after she arrived late. His methods received mixed reviews from local parents and community members, with some criticizing his effectiveness as a teacher while others noted the progress of ambitious pupils under his instruction.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P27](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0027), [v1 c15 P31](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0031), [v1 c15 P89](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0089), [v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037), [v1 c18 P6](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0006), [v1 c18 P10](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0010)_
